issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 06) requires selecting municipalities with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution query uses thresholds of 10,000 (WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This numeric mismatch changes the set of rows returned and would confuse students about the intended selection criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the threshold consistent. Update solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql to use 100000 in the WHERE clause (WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000) to match the problem statement, or if the intended threshold is 10,000, update the problem statement to state 10,000 instead. Prefer updating the solution to 100000 to match the written task.
